digest.component_or_area: LLM evaluation harness and Bedrock provider integration
propositions: A provider-parity measurement harness must establish that the same request payloads and tool sets reach the LLM regardless of provider before Bedrock can be claimed as a first-class provider.
Bedrock inference-profile ids must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 and the configuration must route provider-clean with zero non-Bedrock calls on the Bedrock-configured arm.

The harness must exclude agentic disposable-store reviewers (completion-verifier, ticket-quality, spec-alignment) and pool gold items across non-agentic specs to meet the parity bar's MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20 floor.

Payload parity and tool parity must be proven by captured outbound requests at the provider boundary, not by reading code, with all legitimate envelope differences enumerated and tested for regression.
LLM non-determinism between different models is expected and out of scope; decision-level agreement and verdict comparisons are informational evidence only, not gates.
